rule: A work in this file is IN COPYRIGHT: it may be read and measured, and never adapted. What crosses into our work is the FORM -- how it teaches, how it is structured, how it is pitched -- and never the protected text. This is the same line the catalog's gate draws between a myth told in the style of a classic and borrowed protected prose.
